    qaoa_result = qaoa.run(parameters)
    
    return circuit, parameters, qaoa_result

    # Create a VQE instance
    vqe = VQE(graph, optimizer="LBFGS", optimizer_params={"maxiter": 50})
    
    # Define the objective function
    def objective(params):
        # Evaluate the max-cut
        result = vqe.run(parameters=params)
        # Compute the maximum cut value
        cut_value = result.eigenvalue
        return -cut_value
    
    # Run the QAOA algorithm
    qaoa_result = qaoa_result
    qaoa_result = qaoa_result
    result = vqe.run()
    
    # Compute the approximation ratio
    cut_value = -result.eigenvalue
    approximation_ratio = np.exp(cut_value)
    
    # Return the results
    return approximation_ratio, qaoa_result, circuit.depth, qaoa_result.num_parameters, qaoa_result.shots, vqe.num_optimizer_calls
